title: Managing Director (m/f/d) - Focus on Accounting & Office
Solutions Engineer UAS / Aviation
Growth Associate (Intern)
description:
Who we are

Melotech is revolutionizing media and entertainment. We create art through technology for humans to enjoy. In just 24 months, our work has been heard, watched and loved for over 4 billion minutes worldwide.

Founded by entrepreneur and investor Soheil Mirpour, we are backed by top VCs Cherry Ventures, Speedinvest and GFC, alongside world-class angels from firms such as Spotify, Blackstone and KKR.

 

What you will do

Melotech is scaling fast, and organic reach is one of the engines behind it. As Growth Associate (Intern), you help run that engine end to end: the creators, the formats, the trends and the numbers behind them. This is an organic growth role first, measured on how much reach every hour and every euro brings back. You work directly with our founders, our Growth Manager, product and data team.

Today that means a steady stream of new products that each deserve a shot at going viral across TikTok, Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts. Your first job is to build the machine behind that: find the creators and communities that move culture, turn what works into repeatable playbooks, and run more experiments in a week than most teams run in a quarter.

 

On a typical day, your tasks may include:

  • Creator network: finding, briefing and paying creators and pages at scale, from small accounts with loyal audiences to the ones that set trends, and keeping the ones that deliver

  • Seeding: getting our products into the formats and communities where they can travel, at the right moment and in the right volume

  • Trend spotting: catching formats and memes early and moving on them within days, not weeks

  • Experiments: running many cheap tests every week, with clear rules for what wins and what gets killed, and turning the winners into playbooks the team can repeat

  • New channels: finding places where attention is still cheap, from fan pages and communities to platforms nobody on the team is using yet

  • Organic and paid together: working with our Growth Manager so organic winners get scaled with paid, and what paid learns feeds back into organic

  • Measurement: knowing which number answers which question, for example what saves and shares tell you that views do not, and what each view really costs

  • Tooling: building the trackers, scripts and automations you need, with platform data and AI tools as your daily coworkers

 

Who you are

We're looking for a student or recent graduate who lives on the platforms and wants to learn how to make content travel.

Typically, your profile will look like this:

  • Platform fluency: you know TikTok, Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts well and can explain why a post performs

  • Hands-on experience: you have grown an account, a page or a side project, or supported a startup or brand on social

  • Creator marketing: you enjoy working with creators and have a feel for content that looks native

  • Creativity: you bring fresh ideas and test them in a structured way

  • Analytical: you are comfortable with numbers and spreadsheets; SQL, Python or AI tools are a plus

  • Pace: you thrive in a fast-paced and performance-oriented environment

  • A big plus: you are a creator yourself, or have run pages with a real following

  • Academics: pursuing or recently graduated with a degree at a top-tier university, with an outstanding academic record: grades, scholarships or awards to show for it

 

What makes this exciting

You own a lever the whole company feels. Every breakout you engineer shows up directly in how fast we can grow, at a fraction of what paid reach would cost. You're not a cog in the machine but the captain of your own ship, rewarded for performance and respected for leadership. Flat hierarchies mean that your voice matters, your ideas get implemented, and your impact is immediate.

We pay competitive salaries and make you an owner of the business with equity. We work remotely to give you complete freedom over your life, while meeting regularly around the world for global offsites where we strategize, bond, and push boundaries together.

 

What the process will look like

We hire on a rolling basis. Earliest starting date is always ASAP.

Once you begin our process, you can progress from start to offer within a week, depending on how quickly you can move through each stage:

  1. Initial interview: 30-minute introductory call, getting to know you

  2. Case interview: 90-minute case discussion, present and debate your skills

  3. Founder interview: 90-minute interview with our CEO, going deep on all topics

  4. Offer, contract signing and onboarding

 

Note: As we are still in stealth, you will learn more about Melotech as you progress through the stages. By the end of the Founder interview, you will have a full grasp of our business and the details of your role.

title: Account Executive, Germany
description:
About Wayflyer

Today's small businesses need a capital provider that keeps pace with their growth ambitions. Traditional financing options are slow, cumbersome and often out of reach. That's why we built Wayflyer.

Our technology allows us to assess businesses in minutes, generate financing offers that reflect their growth potential and send funds in as little as 24 hours. To date, we've deployed over $6bn to thousands of businesses worldwide, backed by Tier 1 banks like J.P. Morgan.

You'll be collaborating with ambitious colleagues from around the world. We have offices in Dublin, London, New York, Charlotte, Berlin and Sydney.

The challenge

There are thousands of businesses globally growing fast and hitting the same wall - they need capital, and traditional lenders are too slow, too rigid, or simply not interested. We've already deployed over $6bn to growing businesses like these. The opportunity in front of us is significant, and we need people who can capitalise on it.

 

What you'll actually do

You'll own the full sales cycle from sourcing your own leads to closing deals with some of the most exciting consumer brands in Germany. You'll run in-depth discovery calls using MEDDPICC, work closely with our underwriting team to move fast without cutting corners, and negotiate deals that genuinely work for both sides. You'll have a dedicated BDR alongside you, but you won't wait around for a full pipeline to land in your lap. The best AEs here source relentlessly, close confidently, and treat their customers like business partners, not transactions. Top performers are hitting ~200% of target. That's not a boast. It's a signal of what’s possible.

 

What this role could turn into

Account Executives at Wayflyer tend to grow in one of two directions - first on the ground in one of our emerging verticals, or into team leadership as we scale. We're continuing to launch new products and verticals, which means the people who perform here will have real options. We'd rather promote from within than hire from outside, and our track record reflects that.

 

Who thrives here
You've worked a full sales cycle before, and you didn't just hit your number; you understood exactly why you hit it and what to do differently when you didn't. You source your own pipeline without being asked, and you don't wait for perfect conditions to start. You're energised by ambiguity, not paralysed by it. You push deals forward when others would wait for a signal. When a sceptical founder pushes back, you lean in. You've been told "no" and come back with a better question. You care about eCommerce and small business growth, not as a line on a cover letter, but as a genuine reason you want this job.

We hire for range
Full sales cycle experience across a range of deal values (think: $10K to 100K) in SaaS or FinTech, ideally with time spent as an outbound BDR/SDR. You know what it takes to build a pipeline from scratch, not just work it. A consistent track record of exceeding targets matters more than tenure. Resilience shows up in your history: you've had a bad quarter, figured out why, and bounced back stronger. MEDDPICC familiarity is required, and you'll need to speak German fluently. Startup or scale-up experience helps; the pace here is real, the playbook is still being written, and we need people who see that as an opportunity, not a risk.

 

Location and working policy

📍Berlin, hybrid (3-4 days per week in the office)

 

The good stuff

25 days off, plus public holidays. Equity - because you should own a piece of what you're building. Generous parental leave for primary and secondary caregivers. 60 days a year to work abroad from wherever you want.

Location

This is a full-time position based in Munich or Cologne. Following a comprehensive onboarding period at our HQ in central Zurich (minimum one month), you will work from your home location, with regular visits to customers across the DACH region.

Team collaboration matters a lot to us. You will regularly spend time with the team in person, in Zurich and at our hubs, for team days, all-hands and offsites. These visits are financially supported by blp.

Your Mission

You get customers live. Hands on, end to end, and fast.

As a Senior Project Manager, you make large, global blp transformations happen. These programs touch finance, procurement and supply chain at once, run across multiple ERP systems and legal entities, and roll out country by country. Your job is to orchestrate all of it and get the customer live: the first go-live above all, because that is where credibility is won or lost, and then wave after wave with the same discipline. You run the steering committee, you lead a blp team on each engagement, and you do that across several engagements at once.

At both levels, scope is the single biggest lever on whether a project goes live on time. Protecting it is a daily job, not a contract clause. You escalate early and precisely rather than absorbing problems until they become critical.

You will not be alone with the technical side. Integrations Engineers handle the connection into the ERP, Technical Project Managers handle the harder solution design, and our Consultants take over the automation work after go-live. On our largest strategic accounts a Client Partner carries the relationship and the commercial number, so your attention goes to delivery quality.

We have done this many times, so you are not inventing the approach each time. A proven onboarding method and a strong toolkit are what let you carry your own customers from early on.

Your Career Path in Project Management

This is the path most of our delivery leadership came through, and we hire at every step of it. We place you according to your experience and the size of the programs you have delivered, and we are explicit about what the next step requires.

  • Project Manager: You get customers live end to end, several in parallel: guided onboarding for commercial customers, leading enterprise projects yourself, or a workstream on our largest programs. Typically you bring 2+ years in consulting, implementation or project management.

  • Senior Project Manager: You make large, global transformations happen: multiple ERPs, entities and countries, the steering committee, and a blp team on each engagement. Typically you bring 5+ years delivering complex, multi-country programs.

  • Next steps: Lead a delivery team, or move into Consulting and from there towards our Client Partner role on strategic accounts.

Moves into Consulting or Customer Success Engineering are open at every level, and many of our people make them.

Key Responsibilities

  • Run implementations end to end: kick-off, scope, planning, configuration, testing and go-live.

  • Manage several customers in parallel at different stages, and keep every one of them on date.

  • Work with customers on their processes, and flag early where a process assumption will not hold.

  • Coordinate the specialists on your projects: Integrations Engineers, Technical Project Managers and AI Automation Specialists.

  • Own scope actively. Recognize a change request for what it is and handle it deliberately.

  • Keep the project inside its budget, and raise it early when the effort is drifting.

  • Hand over cleanly at go-live to our Consultants and support organization.

In addition, as a Senior Project Manager

  • Own the delivery outcome of global programs from kick-off to the last go-live: plan, scope, dependencies and date.

  • Drive the first go-live relentlessly, then run wave planning across ERPs, entities and countries.

  • Run the steering committee and own the decisions that come out of it.

  • Write and execute the recovery plan when a program is off track.

  • Lead the blp team on each engagement and coach the Project Managers working on your programs.

What We're Really Looking For

The following key attributes ensure success in this role:

  • Scope Discipline – You notice when a project is quietly growing, and you raise it rather than absorbing it.

  • Ownership & Autonomy – You take initiative, move things forward, and deliver end to end without being chased.

title: Senior Customer Success Manager / Key Account Manager (m/w/d)
description:
hellomed ist die führende digitale Pflege-Apotheke für Pflegeunternehmen – nach dem Motto: Dauermedikation nur in einfach!

Unsere Vision ist es, bis 2030 die jährlichen 250.000 Krankenhauseinweisungen aufgrund von Medikationsfehlern und die damit verbundenen 1,2 Milliarden Euro Folgekosten zu vermeiden und der Pflege wieder zurückzugeben.

Mit unserer innovativen hellomedOS-Software entlasten wir Pflegekräfte bei der täglichen Medikationsversorgung ihrer Patienten und machen diese noch sicherer. Unser revolutionäres Konzept bringen wir mit einem bunten Team aus Apothekern, Pflegeexperten und Entwicklern auf die Straße – namhafte Investoren sind bereits mit an Bord und Pflegekräfte deutschlandweit lieben das Produkt.

Für unsere größten Kunden – Träger und Pflegeunternehmen mit mehreren Standorten – suchen wir eine erfahrene Persönlichkeit, die diese Partnerschaften betreut, ausbaut und unsere Kundenbetreuung mit uns gemeinsam weiterentwickelt.

Aufgaben

  • Großkunden betreuen: Du betreust unsere größten Pflegeunternehmen und Träger – von der Einführung bis zur langfristigen Zusammenarbeit – und bist feste Ansprechperson für Geschäftsführungen, Regional- und Pflegedienstleitungen.

  • Versorgung im Alltag sichern: Du sorgst dafür, dass alle vereinbarten Patienten auch tatsächlich über hellomed versorgt werden, und schulst Pflegeteams und Leitungen im sicheren Umgang mit hellomedOS – vor Ort und digital.

  • Kundenbeziehungen ausbauen: Du erkennst, wo wir bei bestehenden Kunden weitere Standorte und Patienten versorgen können, und setzt das gemeinsam mit unserem Vertrieb um. Dein Erfolg zeigt sich im Wachstum deiner Kundenbeziehungen.

  • Gespräche auf Leitungsebene: Du führst regelmäßige Gespräche mit den Geschäftsführungen deiner Kunden – was läuft gut, wo gibt es Potenzial, was braucht der Kunde als Nächstes?

Qualifikation

title: Director, European Government Operations
description:
ABOUT ROCKET LAB

Rocket Lab is the end-to-end space company building rockets, spacecraft, and critical subsystems that keep the world connected, protected, expand humanity's reach to the Moon, Mars, and beyond. We move fast, build real hardware for meaningful missions, and make the impossible routine. Come shape the future with us.

DIRECTOR – EUROPEAN GOVERNMENT OPERATIONS

As the Director – European Government Operations, based in Munich/ Berlin, Germany, you will lead Rocket Lab's government affairs strategy across Germany and the broader European region. You will play a critical role in advancing Rocket Lab's business objectives by shaping policy environments, building strategic government relationships, and ensuring alignment between Government Affairs and Business Development. In this role, you will work at the intersection of aerospace innovation, national security, and European public-sector engagement. To be successful, you must be results‑oriented, proactive, politically astute, and deeply comfortable operating in complex, fast‑moving environments. Join a driven team of pioneers relentlessly tackling challenging projects, delivering on the impossible, and making an impact on the future of space.

WHAT YOU'LL GET TO DO

  • Build and lead Rocket Lab's in‑house European Government Operations function, delivering the same level of strategic support and government engagement the company receives in the U.S. market
  • Develop and lead Rocket Lab's government affairs strategy in Germany and across Europe, ensuring alignment with corporate priorities and business development objectives
  • Build and maintain high‑impact relationships with key German federal stakeholders, including the Bundestag, DLR, Ministry of Defense, and relevant regulatory and executive agencies
  • Establish and grow Rocket Lab's presence with government entities and innovation ecosystems in Munich and other strategic European hubs
  • Partner closely with the Business Development team to support market expansion, customer engagement, and pursuit of government‑funded programs
  • Shape and influence policy discussions related to space, defense, launch, and emerging technologies, ensuring Rocket Lab's interests are represented and understood
  • Provide strategic guidance on political, regulatory, and industrial‑policy developments across Europe, identifying opportunities and risks for business
  • Represent Rocket Lab in industry associations, working groups, and public‑sector forums to strengthen the company's visibility and credibility
  • Drive measurable business outcomes through targeted government engagement not only monitoring policy trends but actively shaping them
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to senior leadership on European political dynamics, defense priorities, and government procurement pathways

YOU'LL BRING THESE QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor's degree in political science, international relations, public policy, law, economics, engineering, or a related field
  • 12+ years of experience in government affairs, public policy, defense, aerospace, or related strategic roles within Germany or Europe
  • Professional fluency in German and English
  • Demonstrated success building and managing relationships with senior government officials, policymakers, and public‑sector institutions
  • Proven ability to drive business‑aligned outcomes through government engagement, not solely policy monitoring
  • Strong understanding of European political structures, defense priorities, and government procurement processes
  • Ability to operate autonomously, set strategy, and execute in a fast‑paced, high‑growth environment
  • Exceptional communication, negotiation, and stakeholder‑management skills

THESE QUALIFICATIONS WOULD BE NICE TO HAVE

  • Background in space, aerospace, defense, or dual‑use technology sectors
  • Experience working with or within institutions such as DLR, MOD, Bundestag committees, EU defense bodies, or national innovation agencies
  • Prior roles in business development, defense industrial policy, or public‑sector consulting
  • Experience working in Munich's government, defense, or technology ecosystem
  • Familiarity with NATO, EU defense initiatives, and cross‑border industrial‑cooperation frameworks

This position may require prolonged periods of sitting, standing, walking, computer work, and occasional exposure to moderate levels of noise, dust, and fumes in production areas.

 

WHAT TO EXPECT 

We're on a mission to unlock the potential of space to improve life on Earth, but that's not an easy task. It takes hard work, determination, relentless innovation, teamwork, grit, and an unwavering commitment to achieving what others often deem impossible. Our people out-think, out-work, and out-pace. We pride ourselves on having each other's backs, checking our egos at the door, and rolling up our sleeves on all tasks big and small. We thrive under pressure, work to tight deadlines, and our focus is always on how we can deliver, rather than dwelling on the challenges that stand in the way.   

Important information:

FOR CANDIDATES SEEKING TO WORK IN US OFFICES ONLY:

To conform to U.S. Government space technology export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR), Rocket Lab Employees must be a U.S. citizen, lawful U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State and/or the U.S. Department of Commerce, as applicable. Learn more about ITAR here.

Rocket Lab provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment at Rocket Lab, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

Applicants requiring a reasonable accommodation for the application/interview process for a job in the United States should contact Giulia Johnson at

FOR CANDIDATES SEEKING TO WORK IN NEW ZEALAND OFFICES ONLY:

For security reasons, background checks will be undertaken prior to any employment offers being made to an applicant.  These checks will include nationality checks as it is a requirement of this position that you be eligible to access equipment and data regulated by the United States' International Traffic in Arms Regulations. 

Under these Regulations, you may be ineligible for this role if you do not hold citizenship of Australia, Japan, New Zealand, Switzerland, the European Union, or a country that is part of NATO, or if you hold ineligible dual citizenship or nationality.  For more information on these Regulations, click here ITAR Regulations.

title: Product Manager, Homepage
description:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

Join us in shaping the experience that millions of customers land on every time they open DoorDash, Wolt, or Deliveroo. As part of our Core Consumer organisation, our Homepage team owns one of the single biggest levers we have on what customers find and one of the hardest surfaces in the app to get right.

Working at the intersection of ranking, personalisation, and AI/ML, you'll help decide what each customer sees and why, across three brands and dozens of markets. You'll be building on a global stack, and your roadmap will be a mix: global platform problems that apply worldwide, global capabilities we're accelerating into EMEA, and EMEA-specific problems worth solving properly rather than working around.

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to join our Homepage team. In this role, you'll shape how customers discover restaurants, grocery and retail venues, dishes and products — and help define what discovery looks like as AI-driven and agentic experiences change the way people decide what to order.

What You'll Be Doing

You'll be joining a team working on one of the most-used surfaces in the app.

Here's what your day-to-day might look like:

  • Building new end-to-end features and user experiences on Homepage that shape how customers discover restaurants, grocery and retail venues, dishes, and products.
  • Working on ranking, personalisation, and AI/ML problems in the Homepage domain, including how we decide what each customer sees and why.
  • Exploring where AI-driven and agentic experiences change the way customers discover what to order.
  • Making discovery work across three brands and many markets, without flattening into one-size-fits-all.

What You'll Need to Thrive

Our ideal candidate will bring strong product judgment and curiosity to grow into the rest:

  • Proven experience as a Product Manager on consumer-facing products - discovery, homepage, feed, or ranking-driven experiences are especially relevant.
  • You are a product manager more than a feature owner. Someone who finds the customer problems that matter most and makes the case for solving them.
  • You work backwards from the customer problem, and weigh it against what the business needs most right now.
  • You're comfortable holding several business objectives at once and making a call when they pull in different directions.
  • You work well with a wide range of stakeholders and build trust with people whose priorities differ from your own.
  • You think strategically and can move between long-term direction and what we should ship next.
  • You're comfortable with ambiguity and genuinely flexible (this industry is changing fast, AI most of all).
  • You're curious about what AI actually changes for customers, and can tell real value from hype.

Next steps

The position will be filled as soon as we find the right person, so make sure to apply as soon as you realize you really, really want to join us!

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

Beware of recruitment scams: DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about our legitimate recruiting process at Recruitment Scam Awareness - DoorDash .

description:
About the Role at RobCo

RobCo is building the category of Autonomous Industrial Robotics and we're doing it fast. We believe that automating the ordinary frees humans to do the extraordinary, and we're building the end-to-end robotics infrastructure to make that possible - hardware, software, and AI in one stack that just works.

 

We are now looking for an ambitious Engineering Manager - Robot Intelligence (m/f/d) to help us establish RobCo as a leading provider of autonomous automation solutions.

In this key role, you will lead the “brain” of our autonomous robots - the physical AI harness that works with different models and skills. Managing a full-stack team of software and machine learning engineers, you will balance applied research with business value delivery on a daily basis.

Your mission is to translate the latest advancements in physical AI foundation models and complex robotic functionality into a stable, scalable product that thrives in real-world factory environments.

Your Responsibilities:

  • Drive Engineering Excellence: Set rigorous standards for code quality, automated testing, and CI/CD pipelines to ensure 24/7 reliability of our robots.

  • Lead Senior Talent: Act as a people-first leader for a team of Senior and Staff engineers, fostering a culture of high ownership and steady delivery.

  • Bridge Software and Hardware: Oversee the lifecycle of products spanning from ML training, AI inference to Linux-based industrial interfaces.

  • Balance Research and Delivery: Establish a strong applied research and experimentation culture, and build a process where the results directly contribute to delivery and practical outcomes.

  • Management Framework: Work with real-time metrics and steer the team to continuously improve productivity, predictability and quality of what we ship.

  • Operational Governance: Manage technical debt and architectural health to ensure long-term system stability as we scale.

  • Strategic Alignment: Partner with Product Management to transform customer needs into concrete technical requirements and actionable sprints.

  • Cross-Team Leadership: Mentor junior EMs and help evolve company-wide engineering best practices and software-first principles.

We are looking for someone who has:

  • Completed a university degree in Computer Science, Robotics, Engineering, Data Science or a related field.

  • 3+ years of experience leading high-performing teams in complex technical environments like robotics or industrial IoT.

  • Deep experience with AI and machine learning, including dataset curation, model training and optimization techniques and hands on experience building agentic harnesses.

  • Proven track record of driving an AI-first engineering culture and implementing agentic workflows that measurably accelerate team velocity and system efficiency.

  • Expert knowledge in modern SDLC practices, with a track record of improving deployment frequency and system stability.

  • Culture-aligned mindset characterized by hardware empathy, a passion for software-defined hardware, and a strong culture of high ownership.

  • Strong experience with full-stack software development, robotics engineering is a big plus.

  • Very good English skills with the ability to navigate complex architectural discussions with Staff engineers while clearly communicating risks to stakeholders.

Why join RobCo?

  • Develop modular, software-defined robotics solutions with us that set new standards in automation.

  • Help us build robots equipped with state-of-the-art AI that perceive their environment, analyze data, and make intelligent decisions in real time.

  • As part of a very dynamic and fast-growing scale-up, you will take on responsibility from day one, drive your own projects, and see the direct impact of your work.

  • Flat hierarchies, open communication, and regular 360° feedback enable fast decisions and support your professional and personal development.

  • Wellpass membership (7,200+ studios across Germany), regular team events, and a team that takes both the work and the culture seriously.

  • Flexible working hours, a modern office, and - depending on the role - the option to work from home.

  • Regular team events - from relaxed beer & pizza nights on the rooftop terrace to shared experiences on ski trips or at Oktoberfest.

About RobCo

Founded in Munich in 2020, RobCo leads the transition toward fully Autonomous Industrial Robotics. Our mission is to deploy RobCo in every factory - solving the industrial labor shortage through end-to-end robotics that just works. Powered by Physical AI, our solutions combine a scalable modular hardware architecture with intelligent software that adapts to your use case, improves over time, and requires zero upfront investment through our Robotics-as-a-Service (RaaS) model.

We solve our customers' most pressing pain points - labor shortage, cost pressure, workplace safety, and national reshoring - across the full spectrum of Autonomous Industrial Robotics. With $160M raised from investors including Lightspeed, Lingotto Innovation, and Sequoia, 200+ people globally, and 2.5M+ operating hours in the field, we are deploying robots in factories across Europe and the United States - with our US operations headquartered in Austin, TX, and our RobCo Bay Area Demo Lab in San Francisco.

At RobCo, applicants are selected regardless of ethnic origin, religion, gender, age, disability, or sexual orientation. All decisions throughout the recruitment process are based solely on applicants’ qualifications, skills, knowledge, and experience, as well as relevant business requirements.

title: Senior QA Engineer - Berlin
description:
About RA

Resident Advisor has been a home for electronic music culture since 2001. Event discovery, ticketing, news and long-form editorial, artist profiles, original films, and a weekly mix series two decades deep. Around 7 million people use the web platform every month, with a wider audience across our apps and other channels. Underneath the platform sits a network of contributors and city managers across dozens of cities, which is how we stay connected to the scenes we cover rather than reporting on them from a distance. RA is 25 years old, independent, B.Corp certified and intent on being indispensable to the artists, promoters and audiences who make this culture.

Purpose of the role

As our Senior QA Engineer, you'll look after the quality of ra.co, our iOS and Android apps, and RA Scan, the app promoters use to scan tickets at the door. You'll work across five product teams. Each team writes and runs its own tests. You'll help them do it well, keep the automated test suites healthy, and test the riskiest releases yourself.

Some of what we ship carries real risk: payments, checkout, and getting people into venues on the night. Other changes are a line of copy. You'll help us tell the two apart and test each one accordingly. We use AI tools across development, and you'll help the teams use them to write better tests, faster.

Key responsibilities

  • Keep the web end-to-end test suite healthy: fix flaky tests, add coverage for new features, and make sure a failing suite gets fixed quickly
  • Grow automated testing for our iOS and Android apps and RA Scan with the app developers, so mobile tests run on every change
  • Test high-risk releases yourself, such as payments and checkout, including edge cases and what happens when things fail
  • Review the test plans teams write, and help them improve
  • Use AI tools to write and maintain tests, help developers do the same, and check what the tools produce
  • Brief our external testing partner and review the results they send back
  • Report bugs clearly, and follow them through with developers and product managers
  • Track a few simple measures, such as bugs that reach production and how reliable the automated tests are

We’re looking for

  • Several years in QA or test engineering, typically four or more, testing web and mobile products
  • Hands-on test automation: you've built and maintained automated tests that run in CI, for web (for example Playwright, Cypress or Selenium) and ideally mobile. We use XCUITest on iOS and Espresso with Kotlin on Android
  • Enough coding to write and fix tests alongside developers, in a language such as JavaScript, TypeScript, Kotlin or Swift
  • You can test APIs and check data with SQL
  • Good judgement about risk: what to test deeply, what lightly, and what not at all
  • You've used AI tools in your testing work, and know where they help and where they don't
  • Clear writing: bug reports and test plans other people can act on

If you meet most of these but not all, we'd still like to hear from you. Nobody arrives with all of it, and we'll help you grow into the rest.

Nice to have

  • CircleCI or a similar CI tool
  • Working with an external testing partner
  • Payments, checkout or ticketing systems
  • Testing apps used at live events, with poor networks
  • Test management tools such as Qase or TestRail

What we offer you

  • Generous annual leave policies aimed at promoting work-life balance.
  • Matched pension, or 401k for US staff.
  • Comprehensive staff wellbeing initiatives, featuring regular activities and workplace programmes to support mental and physical health. This includes discounted ClassPass memberships and custom-fitted earplugs.
  • Company-led social events, team lunches, and discounts on merch.
  • Paid annual volunteering allowance, encouraging contributions to community projects and charities you care about.
  • A transparent internal company culture committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion (see: https://ra.co/about/diversity).
  • Active involvement in community projects within the electronic music community (see: https://ra.co/about/community).

More about RA

We are independent and we intend to stay that way. 25 years in, RA answers to the culture it came from rather than to outside stakeholders. That is what enables us to make decisions on a long-term basis.

Our staff, contributors and international teams are not observers. They are part of the scenes we cover, and that is what we hire for. Craft first, and then a genuine stake in this music rather than just a job in it.

RA has been B Corp certified since 2024, which holds us to standards on social and environmental impact we would want to meet regardless of the badge.

We especially welcome applicants from diverse backgrounds, abilities, ethnicities, experiences, gender identities, and sexual orientations.

Our values

  • Electronic music is art.
  • We celebrate the progressive values that underpin electronic music.
  • We advocate for a more inclusive and equitable electronic music community.
  • We honour the past, present and future of electronic music.
  • We use innovation to empower the community.
  • We choose honesty over gain and purpose over profit.
  • We're always front left.

Listing details

This role is a full-time, permanent position, based in Berlin. Please note: this position requires applicants to be based in Berlin and to work from the office three days per week. The annual salary range for this role is €60,000 to €72,000. If you have questions about the role, please contact

title: Interim Senior BI Analyst (All Genders)
description:
Across Europe, fleets are under enormous pressure. Fuel costs are rising. Regulatory requirements are tightening. The shift to low-emission vehicles is accelerating. And yet around 70% of European businesses still manage their fleets manually, with spreadsheets, disconnected tools, and processes that were never built for this moment. Shiftmove exists to make this simple.

We are a profitable B2B SaaS company and the fastest-growing fleet management platform in Europe, born from the merger of Avrios and Vimcar, and now serving tens of thousands of corporate customers across Germany, France, Spain, Switzerland, Poland, and beyond. Most recently, we acquired Optimum and Ocean in France, expanding our footprint and doubling down on one of Europe's largest fleet markets. Our AI-powered platform connects real-time vehicle data with intelligent software so that businesses can procure smarter, control costs, stay compliant, and lead the transition to cleaner mobility, all from one place.

About the role:

We are looking for an experienced Interim Senior BI Analyst to join us on an initial three-month contract, with the option to extend for a further three months.

As we integrate two acquired French businesses into our group, we need to bring their data into our standard reporting while transforming how our executive team accesses and uses business intelligence. Our existing Tableau dashboards have evolved over time, and we see an opportunity to make them clearer, more consistent and more actionable.

Reporting to our VP of Operations, Data & BI, you will work closely with the executive team, Head of FP&A, RevOps and Data Engineering. You will take ownership of rebuilding our executive reporting, responding to daily analytical requests and ensuring that acquired-company data is accurately reflected in group-wide reporting.

This is a hands-on role for someone who combines strong technical BI skills with commercial acumen, sound analytical judgement and the confidence to challenge senior stakeholders when the data tells a different story.

What You'll Do

  • Rebuild executive reporting: Audit our existing Tableau dashboards and the underlying business logic. Decide which dashboards to retain, consolidate, redesign or retire, and rebuild the priority dashboards so executives can quickly understand performance and make informed decisions
  • Establish consistent metrics: Document and align metric definitions to ensure that business performance is measured consistently across dashboards, teams and entities
  • Own daily ad hoc reporting: Manage requests through our Jira-based data support queue, prioritising, scoping and delivering analyses on a daily basis. Translate ambiguous requests into clear business questions and identify recurring needs that can be addressed through standard reporting
  • Integrate acquisition data: Partner with Data Engineering as acquired-company data is migrated into Snowflake. Validate and reconcile data against source systems, build and maintain dbt models, and incorporate the data into existing Tableau dashboards so group reporting reflects all entities
  • Deliver commercial insights: Translate executive requirements into meaningful analysis of go-to-market performance, including pipeline, bookings, ARR, retention and churn
  • Partner with Finance: Work closely with the Head of FP&A to reconcile BI reporting with financial figures and establish a consistent view of business performance
  • Present findings and challenge assumptions: Communicate insights directly to the executive team, explain what the data means for the business, and challenge assumptions where the evidence supports a different conclusion
  • Enable a smooth handover: Document dashboards, data models, metric definitions and reporting processes so the permanent BI team can take ownership of the work at the end of the interim period

What You Need to Succeed

  • You bring extensive experience in BI or analytics, including at least three years working at a senior level
  • You have expert-level Tableau dashboard development skills, including experience redesigning dashboards for executive audiences
  • You have strong SQL skills and hands-on experience working with Snowflake
  • You have practical experience with dbt, including building and maintaining data models, tests and documentation
  • You understand go-to-market performance and are fluent in metrics such as pipeline, bookings, ARR, net and gross retention, and churn
  • You have a track record of translating executive requirements into analysis that informs business decisions
  • You have experience integrating acquired, migrated or otherwise disparate data sources into existing reporting environments
  • You are comfortable managing a Jira ticket queue and delivering reporting requests within daily turnaround expectations
  • You communicate exceptionally well in written and spoken English and are confident presenting to C-level stakeholders, including challenging assumptions when the data warrants it
  • You are based in Europe and available to work 35 hours per week for the duration of the contract

Nice to have:

  • French or German language skills
  • Experience in a SaaS or subscription-based business
  • Experience working with Salesforce, HubSpot or NetSuite data models
  • Experience building a semantic layer or self-service analytics capabilities for executive stakeholders
  • Experience reporting to private equity investors or preparing board-level reporting packs

What Success Looks Like

We want you to make a tangible impact from the start

  • By Day 30: Complete an audit of existing dashboards and underlying business logic, with a clear recommendation to retain, consolidate, redesign or retire each dashboard. Take ownership of the Jira queue and establish a reliable daily delivery rhythm
  • By Day 90: Have the priority executive dashboards rebuilt and in use, agree metric definitions with the Head of FP&A, and bring the first acquired-company data into standard group reporting
  • By Day 180 (if extended): Complete the rebuild of all in-scope dashboards, incorporate all migrated acquisition data into standard reporting, convert recurring ad hoc requests into standard reports, and complete the handover to the permanent BI team

Why Shiftmove

Why should you join us? At Shiftmove, you can contribute to an established, product-led company focused on delivering real value to its customers, with meaningful recurring revenue and an ambitious agenda for growth

  • Autonomy: We bring you in for your expertise and give you the ownership and space to deliver meaningful results.
  • Impact: Play a direct role in shaping executive reporting and integrating acquired businesses into a consistent, group-wide view of performance
  • Fair and equitable compensation: Interim compensation will be discussed based on your expertise, experience and geographic location
  • Dog-friendly office: Because furry coworkers make everything better! 🐶

SOUNDS LIKE YOU?

If you don't tick all the boxes but believe you can thrive in this role, we would love to hear from you.

Shiftmove is an equal opportunity employer. We believe diverse experiences and demographic characteristics that have nurtured unique viewpoints benefit our growth and performance. Just be yourself, and maybe you'll bring something valuable to the role we didn't initially think of.

If you need specific accommodations (tools, time, etc.) due to any special needs, and you are happy to disclose this, please let us know. We are happy to make adjustments, as support can make a decisive difference in the application process.

We're hiring an IT Program Manager who will be at the centre of how Moss buys, manages and eventually retires technology. You'll own the vendor and contract landscape, steer the Tech Operations budget, and lead the company-wide platform migrations and consolidations that come a few times a year.

You'll report to the CISO and work closely with our Tech Operations engineers and Information Security team, alongside Legal, People Ops and FP&A, across a technology estate spanning 350 people and five offices.

Your responsibilities

  • Own vendor and contract negotiations across Moss's SaaS, tooling, infrastructure and connectivity providers, running competitive evaluations to build commercial leverage and maintaining the renewal calendar and contract repository

  • Plan and steer the Tech Operations budget, creating cost transparency per team and driving licence right-sizing, optimisation and consolidation across the tool estate

  • Partner with teams across Moss to understand how tools are actually used, matching licence tiers to real usage and deciding which overlapping tools to keep based on what genuinely serves people, not just cost

  • Drive down the number of tools Moss runs by finding shadow IT, bringing it into the process or consolidating it, and owning retirement work together with Information Security

  • Lead company-wide technology migrations and retirements end to end, from business case and migration plan through cutover, communication and training

  • Bring structure to how work reaches Tech Operations, building a clear intake process and owning the KPIs and monthly management reporting for the domain

  • Work with Legal on contracts and DPAs and with People Ops on joiners and leavers, owning the commercial relationship and negotiation for the vendors in your portfolio within Moss's existing Vendor Management framework

About you

  • Several years of experience in IT vendor management, procurement, sourcing, tech operations or IT service management, ideally gained in a scaling company

  • Proven experience negotiating with vendors and providers, including on service levels and cost

  • Experience leading at least one company-wide tool migration or consolidation end to end, including decommissioning the old system

  • A hands-on IT background, enough to keep essential services running from documented runbooks in an emergency

  • AI is core to how we work. We expect someone with an "AI Driver" toolkit: measurable, real-workflow AI use with concrete before/after impact, ideally including built automations or agents (n8n, Claude skills, or similar).

  • German at C1 or above, prior experience in a regulated environment (financial services, payments or e-money), exposure to ISO 27001, SOC 2 or DORA, or an ITIL/IAITAM qualification are all a plus

In addition, here are the skills and attributes we are looking for:

  • A talent for moving things forward through clarity and good process rather than hierarchy

  • Comfortable owning commercial outcomes inside a governance framework someone else owns

  • Genuine curiosity about how other teams work, and translating that into better commercial calls than a dashboard would

  • A structured, documentation-friendly way of working, with an instinct for turning manual work into something that runs itself

About Moss

Moss is the Finance AI platform for Europe's mid-sized businesses, giving companies real-time visibility and full control over their spend. By automating card issuing, invoice management and expenses, Moss simplifies financial workflows and frees finance and accounting teams from manual, administrative work.

A central challenge of this role is building and operationalizing our unified healthcare data ontology—a consistent semantic model covering hospitals, departments, specialties, metrics, and classification standards.   • Data Contracts & Schema Governance: Establish strict data contracts (Pydantic, dbt contracts) and schema management, ensuring dataset reproducibility, data lineage tracking, and automated validation across all platform pipelines.

  • Platform Efficiency & Cloud Infrastructure: Optimize data storage, query execution, and compute costs across AWS and Snowflake, keeping data assets performant, secure, and cost-effective.

  • Automation & CI/CD: Implement automated testing and deployment workflows for data pipelines using GitHub Actions and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform).

  • Cross-Functional Data Enablement: Partner directly with Analytics Engineers, Data Scientists, and domain experts to deliver documented, research-grade, and production-ready datasets.

Qualifications

Core Requirements (Must-Haves)

  • Data Ingestion & Pipeline Orchestration: Advanced Python and analytical SQL for complex data ingestion across diverse file formats, REST APIs, databases, and cloud lakes (S3/Iceberg). Hands-on experience with modern orchestrators (Prefect, Airflow, or Dagster).

  • Entity Resolution & Data Governance: Practical experience with entity resolution/record linkage frameworks (e.g., Splink, dedupe, recordlinkage) and schema management/data contracts (Pydantic, dbt contracts, or JSON Schema).

  • Cloud Platform & Warehouse Infrastructure: Deep hands-on experience in an AWS production environment (S3, ECS/EC2) combined with cloud data warehouses (Snowflake).

  • Automated CI/CD & Workflow Automation: Proven track record of automating data pipeline deployments, integration tests, and validation workflows via GitHub Actions.

Nice-to-Haves (What Will Make You Stand Out)

  • Knowledge Graphs & Healthcare Terminologies: Exposure to ontology/semantic frameworks (RDF/OWL, SKOS, Neo4j, LinkML) or international medical classifications/vocabularies (SNOMED CT, ICD/OPS, FHIR).

  • Metadata & Lineage Tooling: Experience operating metadata registries and lineage catalogs (e.g., OpenMetadata, DataHub, dbt docs).

  • Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Proficiency in using Terraform to declaratively manage cloud resources and environments.

Your Profile

  • Degree: Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science, Data Science, Software Engineering, or a related quantitative field.

  • Experience: 3+ years in data engineering building production pipelines and data platforms; including a sustained period within one organization seeing a core platform or product through build → launch → iteration.

  • Domain Knowledge: Healthcare domain experience is a plus (basic understanding of healthcare KPIs, quality metrics, or benchmarking concepts; familiarity with hospital structures and medical classification systems like ICD/OPS is especially valuable).

This role is not a good fit for you if:

About Us

Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.

Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes.

2,100+ customers across 80+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to $200M+ in ARR, with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI, Graceview, Cadastral, and Wexler.

We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.

Joining Legora means three things.

  • We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.

  • We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.

  • We grow together: as a team and with our customers.

Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.

If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.

What you'll do


Let's get the tricky part out of the way: this role doesn't fit neatly into a box. It's part client facing accounting advisory, part product specialist, part solutions architect, and part trusted advisor. If you're looking for a role that stays static, this isn't it.
Your mission is to help some of the world's leading accounting firms get the absolute most out of Legora. You'll partner with clients to understand how they work today, help them rethink how audit work gets done with AI, and ensure they realise lasting value from the platform.
You'll:

  • Act as a trusted advisor to clients, building strong relationships, solving complex challenges, and identifying opportunities to deepen and scale their use of Legora.

  • Support the GTM and Customer Success teams through the sales process from early pilots and onboarding through to firm-wide adoption across Big Four and mid-tier practices.

  • Design practical solutions to complex accounting workflows, helping clients embed Legora into their day-to-day engagements in ways that deliver measurable impact.

  • Deliver engaging product demonstrations, workshops and training that help accounting professionals understand the full potential of the platform.

  • Guide clients through one of the biggest shifts in the profession, helping them evaluate the practical application and business value of generative AI across accounting work, including how it sits alongside methodology and documentation requirements.

  • Act as the voice of the customer within Legora, bringing frontline insights into product development, roadmap priorities and strategic decisions.

  • Build scalable playbooks, best practices and knowledge resources that help us continually improve how we deliver for customers as we grow globally.

  • Partner closely with Product, Engineering and Customer Success to ensure customer feedback translates into meaningful product improvements.


What you'll bring

You're an accountant who enjoys improving the way work gets done. You understand the realities of practice; the deadlines, the review cycles, the file, and are excited by the opportunity to combine that expertise with technology to solve meaningful customer problems.

We're looking for someone who has:

  • A recognised accountancy qualification (ACA, ACCA, CA or equivalent) with experience gained at a leading firm.

  • A strong understanding of accounting workflows and the challenges facing modern engagement teams.

description:
Lieu :    Lyon                                                                           Date souhaitée de démarrage :  11/01/2027

Durée :  6 mois                                                             

« S’engager aux côtés d’HI, c’est agir pour venir en aide aux populations vulnérables que nous soutenons sur le terrain. Pour mener à bien cette mission, nous recherchons des étudiants motivés et prêts à mettre leur énergie au service d’une cause qui a du sens »

HI, Humanité & Inclusion est une organisation de solidarité internationale indépendante et impartiale, qui intervient dans les situations de pauvreté et d’exclusion, de conflits et de catastrophes. Œuvrant aux côtés des personnes handicapées et des populations vulnérables, elle agit et témoigne, pour répondre à leurs besoins essentiels, pour améliorer leurs conditions de vie et promouvoir le respect de leur dignité et de leurs droits fondamentaux.

Chez Handicap International, nous croyons fermement en l'importance de l'inclusion et de la diversité au sein de notre structure. C'est pourquoi nous sommes engagés dans une politique handicap afin de favoriser l'accueil et l'intégration de personnes en situation de handicap.  

Merci d’indiquer si vous avez besoin d’un aménagement particulier, y compris pour participer aux 1ers entretiens. 

 

Pour plus d’information sur l’association : www.hi.org

 

OBJECTIFS DU STAGE :

Le stage se fera au sein du service Sensibilisation - Communication de Handicap International, au siège de Lyon, dans le cadre des missions quotidiennes du service avec un large volet dédié à l’organisation des déploiements des Pyramides de chaussures. Être un soutien au service Sensibilisation - Communication dans leurs actions de sensibilisation et tout projet. 

Nous vous invitons à prendre connaissance des actions de sensibilisation et mobilisation en consultant : l’Espace du bénévolat et de la sensibilisation pour Handicap International.

La mission se déroulera du 11 janvier au 10 juillet 2027 (6 mois).

Les Pyramides de chaussures c’est le temps fort de sensibilisation et de mobilisation citoyenne pour Handicap International. Depuis plus de 30 ans, tous les citoyens, scolaires, salariés d’entreprises, sympathisants de Handicap International ou encore politiques sont invités à venir :

-          Lancer leurs chaussures pour témoigner de leur soutien aux causes portées par Handicap International, la chaussure symbole de l’engagement citoyen pour protéger les civils ;

-          S’informer à travers une exposition interactive, ludique et pédagogique sur Handicap International, ses champs d’intervention et ses combats ;

-          Rencontrer et échanger avec nos experts terrain

Depuis 2024 Handicap International a développé des Pyramides de chaussures dites « mobiles ». Le but ? Être présent toute l’année partout en France. Grâce à ce dispositif nous pouvons aller au plus proche de nos différentes cibles (scolaire, sympathisants, grand public, élus, médias) et leur proposer un temps de sensibilisation complet sur nos missions dans le monde. Pour en savoir plus sur les Pyramides : https://www.handicap-international.fr/fr/pyramides-de-chaussures

Le stage sera orienté autour de trois volets 

-          Appui à la prospection (recherche de structures hôtes ou de partenaires intéressés par des visites guidées)

-          Appui événementiel et logistique pour la préparation et le déroulement des déploiements.

-          Animation auprès du public (visites guidées, actions de sensibilisation, échanges lors d’évènements).

Le stage implique des déplacements réguliers (environ deux par mois) dans le cadre des animations et évènements extérieurs. Ces missions sont l’occasion de belles rencontres et d’échanges enrichissants avec des publics variés.

Le stage combine la prospection de nouveaux lieux de déploiement, l'appui à la coordination événementielle et logistique et l'animation auprès de publics variés. Une bonne connaissance des actions, des valeurs et des prises de position de Handicap International est nécessaire pour adapter les messages de sensibilisation au contexte géopolitique.

Activité 1 : Participer à la préparation et au déploiement des Pyramides de chaussures 2027

-          Prospection : identifier et contacter des villes, structures et partenaires susceptibles d'accueillir une Pyramide ; contribuer au suivi des contacts et des opportunités.

-          Coordination logistique : participer aux rétroplannings, à la préparation du matériel, à la mobilisation des bénévoles et à l'organisation opérationnelle des déploiements.

-          Relations avec les partenaires et prestataires : recherche de contacts, coordination, suivi des engagements, communication et fidélisation.

-          Participation aux événements en France : appui à la coordination sur place, installation et démontage, animation de visites guidées, prises de parole et échanges avec les publics.

-          Bilans et capitalisation : recueillir les retours d'expérience, contribuer aux bilans et à l'amélioration des outils et procédures.

Activité 2 : Soutenir l'organisation d'événements portés par d'autres services

-          Appuyer, selon les besoins, la logistique, la communication ou la prospection pour des événements transversaux (par exemple : vœux, inauguration des nouveaux locaux, Congrès des Notaires ou autres temps forts de l'association).

Activité 3 : Participer à la vie quotidienne du service sensibilisation – communication

-          Contribuer à la gestion de boîtes mail et au suivi des sollicitations, au suivi d'actions solidaires et à la préparation de nouvelles actions ou événements de mobilisation

-          Contribuer à l'animation et au déploiement du défi de Damien Seguin pour l'inclusion et la solidarité internationale, avec un focus sur le volet scolaire : mobilisation et accompagnement des établissements scolaires, diffusion des outils pédagogiques, appui à l'organisation d'actions de sensibilisation et de défis solidaires, suivi des établissements participants et valorisation de leurs initiatives.

Requirements

Niveau Master

Intérêt marqué pour la solidarité internationale et volonté de connaître les actions et valeurs de Handicap International.

Gestion de projet événementiel

Intérêt pour la prospection et la prise de contact avec des partenaires et collectivités.

Aisance relationnelle (interventions orales et tel)

Une expérience associative ou bénévole serait un plus.

Bonne expression écrite et orale.

Goût pour le travail en équipe.

Organisation, rigueur, sens des priorités et capacité d'adaptation.

Bon sens, autonomie et prise d'initiative.

Vous recevrez :

·     Une gratification mensuelle de 693€ pour un stage temps plein, 6 mois (stage à partir du 11 janvier 2026)

Senior Product Manager - Measurement & Reporting
description:
Streaming TV is no longer just a brand awareness channel. It’s becoming a core part of the performance marketing mix, alongside search and social. Vibe.co is building the platform that makes TV work like the rest of the acquisition stack: targeted, measurable, and optimized for results.

Vibe.co is an Audience First Streaming TV Advertising platform that gives marketers the tools to reach the right audiences, optimize campaigns in real time, and understand what’s actually driving business outcomes. With hyper-targeted segmentation, AI-powered recommendations, real-time optimization, and incrementality measurement, Vibe brings the precision and accountability of digital advertising to the biggest screen in the house.

Today, more than 12,000 brands use Vibe.co to reach 120 million+ households. And in August 2026, Vibe.co became a Walmart company, opening up a new chapter for the business and the industry. With Walmart’s first-party data and purchase signals now part of the Vibe platform, advertisers can connect TV advertising to real-world transactions and measure the impact of CTV with a level of precision previously associated with platforms like Google and Meta.

This is a unique moment to join Vibe. With Walmart’s scale, data, and reach behind us, we’re building the next generation of TV advertising and creating a more measurable, performance-driven future for the channel.

About the Role

You’ll own Measurement & Reporting: the product surface where Vibe turns campaign delivery into proof. Performance is why clients pick Vibe. Trusted, actionable measurement is why they stay and scale with us.

Reporting to the VP of Product, you’ll own the strategy and roadmap for how Vibe explains and proves the impact of CTV advertising across every vertical. Your main focus will be ecom and CPG, with growing coverage of apps, local, and travel. The goal is to make CTV outcomes as trustworthy and actionable as search and social, so clients confidently move more budget to Vibe.

You’ll work daily with Data Science, Data Platform, Engineering, and our client-facing teams (CS, Sales, TAM). With Walmart’s purchase data now part of the platform, measurement is becoming one of Vibe’s biggest differentiators.

What You’ll Do

Reporting & Insight

  • Own advertiser-facing reporting, including dashboards, outcome metrics, and exports that make CTV performance clear to both technical and non-technical buyers.

  • Turn raw performance data into benchmarks and insights clients can grasp at a glance.

Attribution & Incrementality

  • Productize attribution and incrementality to a client-grade standard, not just an internal signal.

  • Own integrations with the measurement tools clients already trust, such as MMPs, web/CAPI pixels, MMM, and third-party partners (e.g. Northbeam, Haus), so Vibe’s numbers hold up next to Meta and Google.

  • Guarantee data accuracy, transparent methodology, and defensible results.

Activation

  • Translate measurement into clear recommendations and next actions that drive spend decisions.

  • Close the loop between proven outcomes and campaign optimization, powering the “more performance → more spend” flywheel.

  • Partner with CS, Sales, and TAM to make measurement the core of how we retain and grow clients.

  • Use SQL and log-level data to validate methodologies, size opportunities, and prioritize by impact.

What You Need

  • 5+ years in Product Management on performance AdTech, measurement/attribution, or analytics products.

  • Strong grasp of digital measurement (attribution models, incrementality and causal testing, MMM) and of why click-based models break for CTV.

  • Solid statistical literacy, including experimental design, holdouts, significance, and confidence intervals.

  • A track record of shipping client-facing reporting or insight products, and of making complex data simple and trustworthy for marketers.

  • Fluency with outcome KPIs across verticals and with the ecom/CPG performance stack.

  • Hands-on SQL and data exploration, and you’re comfortable in technical, data-intensive environments.

  • The ability to bridge technical measurement and business/GTM stakeholders.

Why This Role

  • You’ll own the product domain that decides whether clients trust their Vibe spend, and whether they scale it.

  • You’ll have a direct line to revenue, because measurement is Vibe’s main lever for retaining and growing clients.

  • You’ll shape how an entire category proves CTV as a performance channel.

  • You’ll have high autonomy and influence across functions, from data science to clients’ C-suite.

Our Values

At Vibe, we run on three values: Impact, Ambition, and Urgency. We tie every goal to a real business outcome, think 10x rather than settling for good enough, and move daily rather than waiting for perfect conditions.

You’ll thrive here if you own outcomes without needing direction, default to action, and hold yourself to results, not effort.

This is a high-performance environment with high-performance rewards: you’ll work alongside people who push you, with real ownership over hard problems in a market that’s moving fast.

If that sounds like the best version of your career, we want to meet you.

What We Offer

The base pay range for this role in Paris is €99,000 – €133,000. We will support relocation to Paris for great candidates.

The base pay range for this role in New York is $108,000 – $216,000. We will support relocation to New York for great candidates.

At Vibe, we want you to build something, own something, and grow fast. Here’s how we back that up:

  • Variable pay — Based on real Vibe business goals.

  • Hybrid flexibility — We’re in the Heart of Paris and our team is in 3x a week!

  • Health insurance — Full coverage via Alan.

  • Meal vouchers — Via Swile.

  • Annual offsite — The whole team, once a year, somewhere worth the trip.

  • Tech Syncs — Engineering and Product meet in person at least quarterly, worldwide.

Our Interview Process

We respect your time. Here’s exactly what to expect, no surprises, no ghosting.

  1. Recruiter Screen — 30 minutes. We’ll share more context on the role and team, and learn more about your background and what you’re looking for.

  2. Hiring Manager Interview — 45 minutes. Meet with the person you’d work with directly and dive deeper into your experience, product background, and approach to the role.

  3. Technical Discussion — 90 minutes. A deeper conversation covering product thinking, measurement methodology, data reasoning, and a use case relevant to the role.

  4. Bar Raiser Interview — 30 minutes. Meet with a senior leader at Vibe for a final conversation and an opportunity to ask any remaining questions.

  5. Offer — We move quickly once we’ve made a decision. We don’t let good decisions sit.

Equal Opportunity

Vibe is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

We believe the best ideas come from teams with different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences. If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process, please let us know.

Referral Instructions

Being referred? Ask your contact to submit your application directly on your behalf.

title: Senior Customer Success Manager
description:
About Gladia

Gladia builds the audio AI infrastructure behind the new generation of voice products. Our mission is to give every voice platform true conversational intelligence — the audio infrastructure that understands every conversation, turning voice into the world's most valuable data layer.

Our API turns real-world conversational audio into accurate, structured, real-time output — powered by our proprietary Solaria ASR, across 100+ languages, with industry-leading latency.

Hundreds of companies build their voice products on Gladia — from meeting assistants and voice agents to sales-enablement and contact-center platforms. We started in Paris, our growth is developer-led and heavily US-driven (and we're going after the US market hard).

Headquartered in vibrant tech hubs like Paris and New York City, Gladia has been acquired by OVH Groupe — Europe's leading cloud provider — and now operates as a fully autonomous brand and company within the Group.

We're guided by four values:

  • Honest — Say the real thing, kindly.

  • Smart — Work smart, ship fast.

  • Builders — Own your scope, build to last.

  • Caring — Support people, take pride in the craft.


The role

We're looking for a Senior Customer Success Manager to own the relationship with our most strategic customers and make sure they succeed at every step — from onboarding and integration to adoption and long-term value.

You'll be the main point of contact for our customers' technical and product teams, helping them understand, adopt, and scale with our API. The role is hands-on and cross-functional: you'll work closely with Sales, Support, Product, and Engineering to drive customer outcomes.

We're an API-first company, so we're looking for someone who thrives in a technical environment and is obsessed with customer value, satisfaction, and retention. As an AI company, we also expect you to use AI every day to work smarter and serve customers better.

What you'll do

Build a Customer Success structure that works

  • Be our customers’ day-to-day point of contact and give them the support they need, when they need it

  • Set up and improve our CS playbooks, onboarding flows, tooling, and metrics

Own the customer lifecycle

  • Lead end-to-end onboarding for new accounts: setup, training, integration, and early activation

  • Run regular check-ins with your customers, plus business reviews (QBRs) to show the value they get from Gladia

  • Monitor usage and proactively support customers to drive adoption and remove friction

Catch churn early

  • Build a system that surfaces early signs of churn (usage drops, health scores, support signals)

  • Act on those signals quickly to keep customers healthy and satisfied

  • Understand each customer’s goals and help them reach them faster with Gladia

Be the customer’s ears inside Gladia

  • Collect customer needs and feedback, and bring them to Product in a structured way to shape the roadmap

  • Know our roadmap well and dig into it to give customers clear answers on what’s coming

  • Become a trusted advisor to technical stakeholders, product leads, and executives

Use AI to scale Customer Success

  • Use AI tools to automate repetitive work and improve CS workflows (account research, meeting prep and notes, QBR preparation, reporting)

  • Use AI to improve the service we give customers: faster and more accurate answers, better self-serve resources, and earlier detection of churn signals

Who you are

  • 4–7+ years in Customer Success or Technical Account Management

  • Previous experience with an API-first or developer-facing product

  • Obsessed with customer satisfaction and retention: you spot risks before they happen, make sure customers get maximum value from the product, and build long-term, trust-based relationships

  • You've managed a portfolio of strategic or enterprise customers and driven measurable value for them

  • Excellent communicator — you know how to talk to developers, product managers, and executives

  • Organized, autonomous, and process-driven — you're always two steps ahead

  • A daily, hands-on AI user: you’ve already used AI tools to make your work or your customers’ experience better

  • Fluent in English and French

What Gladia offers

  • The compensation offered is based on seniority and experience, and would typically range from €50K to €75K base salary

  • Hybrid work from our offices in the heart of Paris (no compulsory office days)

  • Lunch vouchers (approx. 200€/month)

  • An allowance of 360€/year for your sports activities

  • An allowance of 300€ for the adaptation of your workstation

  • Health insurance (100% coverage) and a pension contract for you & your family

  • Flexible vacation policy

ExcellGene is a Swiss biologics development company based in Monthey, innovating in mammalian cell protein expression and bioprocess development. The company develops cell lines (CHO and HEK) and processes that enable biotech and pharmaceutical clients to produce proteins, from early research to clinical use. Its edge is speed and protein expression know-how. ExcellGene also licenses its own proprietary cell hosts, CHOExpress and HEKExpress.

ARCHIMED took a majority stake in ExcellGene in late 2025.

The role

ExcellGene is hiring a Vice President Product & Marketing to build its product and marketing function and drive the next phase of growth. This is a new role, reporting into the Chief Executive Officer and part of the Executive Leadership Team, to turn product & strategy into a clear offer and steady demand, working side by side with the Vice President of Global Business Development & Sales and the Chief Scientific & Technology Officer

Key responsibilities

  • Market & customer insight: understand customers, market segments, competitors and emerging opportunities.
  • Portfolio & product strategy: shape portfolio around market needs and ExcellGene’s scientific strengths.
  • Positioning & value proposition: clearly articulate why customers should choose ExcellGene.
  • Go-to-market: define and drive GTM strategies for core business and new growth areas.
  • Demand creation: build effective lead-generation programs and targeted campaigns.
  • Sales enablement: equip Sales with insights, messaging and tools to win.
  • New growth platforms: identify and develop new organic opportunities and support the assessment and integration of potential acquisitions.
  • Team leadership: lead and develop the Marketing & Product team (3 people).

This person will connect market, portfolio, positioning, go-to-market and lead generation. He/she will decide where ExcellGene plays, why it wins, and where the next growth platforms come from.

Requirements

Must have

  • A scientific background and education, ideally combined with a business or marketing qualification.
  • 10+ years of relevant experience in product and marketing, including 3-5 years in a leadership role.
  • Strong product and marketing experience in biologics. Cell-line development or protein expression is highly valued.
  • Experience in a CRO, CDMO or other scientific services business, selling development services alongside products.
  • Product marketing and broader marketing, with go-to-market experience at both strategic and hands-on level.
  • The ability to turn complex science into clear customer value and a sharp commercial offer.
  • A start-up mindset: think strategically, do the work yourself and bring an entrepreneurial, hands-on approach.
  • Strong cross-functional skills and the ability to work effectively with scientific, commercial and operational teams.

Nice to have

  • Good understanding of the US market and of Asian markets (India is a plus).

Benefits

  • Location: Monthey, Switzerland
